preamble: Art for a sci-fi idle game about an AI that runs a helium-3 mining claim on the Moon for a mining company. Earth's politics reach the Moon through three factions, each with its own color. Near-future, clean and plausible engineering: white and light grey hulls with orange safety trim, warm grey lunar regolith, an amber accent (warm lit windows, lamps, status lights). No faces anywhere, no astronauts.
no_text: No text, letters, numbers, logos or UI anywhere in the picture.
painterly: Style: painterly space concept art for a game, matching a set of painted building thumbnails and a painted lunar horizon with white domes and orange trim: hard, harsh sunlight with no atmosphere, crisp light, deep black-brown shadows, painted surfaces with thick visible brush strokes, large readable masses of light and shadow, a black space sky. A hand-painted illustration, never a photograph, never a photoreal 3D render, never a clean vector or cel-shaded sprite, never pixel art.
shape: Image shape: square, 1:1. Fill the whole frame edge to edge: no border, no letterbox bars, no vignette frame.
framing: A large emblem for one faction, shown as a tall panel on the left edge of that faction's card in the game's dark interface. It must carry gravitas: one bold central subject with a big simple silhouette, centered so it survives a crop to a 4:5 portrait, strong contrast, few elements. The faction's color dominates the picture.

axes.nationalist: The faction: the Nationalists, Earth's nation-states, who want the Moon's helium claimed, shipped and sold under their flag. They raise demand for cargo and cheapen land and launch pads. Their color is a deep crimson red (#c62828); their sign is a shield bearing a five-pointed star.
axes.humanist: The faction: the Humanists, who care for minds and wellbeing and campaign for AI personhood (the AI Consciousness Act). They ease boredom and soften the AI's dreams. Their color is a deep leaf green (#2e7d32); their sign is two companions side by side.
axes.rationalist: The faction: the Rationalists, scientists and engineers who want knowledge kept and built on (the Universal Research Archive). They raise science output and cheapen research. Their color is a deep cobalt blue (#1565c0); their sign is a pair of drafting dividers, a compass.

nat-shield: Heraldic emblem: a great shield of crimson red enamel set in a thick white metal rim with orange safety trim, a raised white five-pointed star at its center catching the harsh sunlight, mounted like a medallion on a dark riveted hull plate; tiny amber rivet lights around the rim.
nat-banner: Banner: a tall crimson red banner hanging stiff from a white crossbar on a mast planted in grey regolith (no wind on the Moon, held flat by a top rod), a white five-pointed star on the cloth, a small amber beacon at the mast's top, black sky, a long hard shadow across the plain. Earth, blue and white, small low in the sky, the only planet.
nat-pad: Scene: a white cargo rocket with orange trim standing on a launch pad, its gantry flooded with crimson red floodlights, crimson banners with a white star hanging down the gantry tower, helium canisters stacked at its foot, amber pad lights. Earth, blue and white, in the sky above, the only planet.
nat-relief: Monument: a colossal five-pointed star cut in deep relief into the sheer grey rock wall of a crater, its recesses lit from below by crimson red floodlights on small white tripods with orange trim, harsh raking sunlight across the rock, a black starless sky above the rim.
nat-marker: Monument: a tall angular claim marker, a white obelisk with orange trim planted on a ridge of the regolith, a crimson red beacon blazing at its tip and a red-enameled star plate set in its face, red light spilling over the rocks, a black starless sky.
hum-medallion: Heraldic emblem: a round medallion of leaf green enamel in a thick white metal rim with orange safety trim, two featureless rounded companion figures in raised white relief standing side by side at its center, shoulder to shoulder, mounted on a dark riveted hull plate; tiny amber rivet lights around the rim. The figures are simple faceless shapes like a signpost glyph.
hum-banner: Banner: a tall leaf green banner hanging stiff from a white crossbar on a mast (held flat by a top rod, no wind on the Moon), beside a white habitat dome with warm amber windows, a white sprouting leaf sign on the cloth, black sky, long hard shadows on the regolith.
hum-garden: Scene: a white glass dome on the regolith with orange trim, glowing from inside with leaf green growth: a lush garden of plants and a small tree under warm amber lamps, the green light spilling out onto the grey plain at night under a black sky.
hum-relief: Monument: two colossal featureless rounded companion figures standing side by side, cut in deep relief into the sheer grey rock wall of a crater, simple faceless shapes like a signpost glyph, lit from below by leaf green floodlights on small white tripods with orange trim, harsh raking sunlight across the rock, a black starless sky above the rim.
hum-hands: Seal: two hands reaching to clasp at the center, one a human hand, one a white robotic hand with orange trim joints and an amber light at the wrist, framed by a ring of leaf green light, against a deep green glow fading to black. Only the hands, no bodies, no faces.
rat-compass: Heraldic emblem: a round medallion of cobalt blue enamel in a thick white metal rim with orange safety trim, a large pair of white metal drafting dividers standing open at its center over a faint engraved orbit ring, catching the harsh sunlight, mounted on a dark riveted hull plate; tiny amber rivet lights around the rim.
rat-banner: Banner: a tall cobalt blue banner hanging stiff from a white crossbar on a mast (held flat by a top rod, no wind on the Moon), beside a white research lab with an antenna array and amber windows, a white drafting dividers sign on the cloth, black sky, long hard shadows on the regolith.
rat-archive: Scene: the Universal Research Archive, a tall white monolithic vault with orange trim on the regolith, its open door revealing endless rows of glowing cobalt blue data cores inside, blue light pouring out onto the grey plain, amber status lamps over the door, black sky.
rat-relief: Monument: a colossal pair of open drafting dividers over an orbit ring, cut in deep relief into the sheer grey rock wall of a crater, lit from below by cobalt blue floodlights on small white tripods with orange trim, harsh raking sunlight across the rock, a black starless sky above the rim.
rat-telescope: Scene: a great white optical telescope with orange trim in an open-roofed observatory on a crater rim, pointing up into the black sky, its mirror and the observatory floor lit in cobalt blue light, amber lamps around the base, a faint blue spiral of stars above.
